rules.comment: With LIBC_MATH_SKIP_ACCURATE_PASS, functions must not contain the multi-precision helpers used by the accurate pass. The exceptions are correctly rounded basic operations (fused multiply-add and narrowing arithmetic) that use DyadicFloat as their main algorithm rather than as an accurate pass. f128 and long double variants inherently need wide arithmetic.
With LIBC_MATH_SMALL_TABLES, no named data object may exceed 512 bytes. The exceptions are ceilings for the current tables; lower or remove them as tables shrink.

atan.note: atan_internal::ATAN_I; a smaller table is pending

atan2.note: atan_internal::ATAN_I; a smaller table is pending

log10f.note: 128-entry log tables; smaller tables are pending

log2f.note: 128-entry log tables; smaller tables are pending

logf.note: 128-entry log tables; smaller tables are pending

rules.comment: Math functions must not have writable data. The only exceptions are the static volatile variables that the functions in fputil::generic (FPUtil/rounding_mode.h) use to probe the rounding mode, which are not used with LIBC_MATH_ASSUME_ROUND_NEAREST_ONLY (see no-writable-data-round-nearest).
With LIBC_MATH_INTERMEDIATE_COMP_IN_FLOAT, these single precision functions must not call double precision soft-float helpers on targets without a hardware double precision FPU.
